messages:
emily (Sales): Incoming SIG from EdgeBridge, marked urgent by procurement. Deadline Thurs COB.
ryan (SE): Can someone upload the questionnaire file? quick scan will tell if CAIQ or custom.
emily (Sales): Link: https://edgebridge.example/sig/eb-sig-2026.pdf. Main asks: customer-managed keys (HSM), 10-year log retention, annual pen test report.
priya (Security): quick read 8% CAIQ + 5 bespoke questions around key escrow & attestations. HSM requirement is the primary blocker.
oliver-edgebridge: Confirming: must use our HSM for key wrapping during inference. Provider-managed KMS not acceptable for compliance.
ryan (SE): That implies Private (customer-hosted) deployment or Dedicated with customer KMS proxy. Need to know whether they allow a cross-account role in their AWS.
oliver-edgebridge: POC will run in our AWS account, we can grant temporary admin role for setup.
priya (Security): Also: 10-year logs is non-standard for us. Legal/finance will need cost approval. For POC, would they accept a shorter retention + exportable archive?
emily (Sales): I'll ask. Action list: 1) @ryan sketch POC architecture for Private in customer account + key flow 2) @priya draft CAIQ answers marking HSM as "customer infra required" 3) I'll loop legal for contract clause about key ownership. Need updates by tomorrow 11am.
legal-bot: Legal intake created: #SIG-4211. Assigned to contracts@redwood. SLA: 72h.
ryan (SE): ETA: 1.5 engineer-days to wire HSM gateway for demo + 0.5 day to record runbook. Est cost: ~$4k for POC infra.
priya (Security): For the CAIQ reply: I'll call out pen test requirement as "customer-supplied" for POC and request SOC2 or ISO certs.
emily (Sales): Customer reply: procurement will accept exported logs for POC but insists on recorded HSM demo and their pen test report before GA.
ryan (SE): OK. I'll include an IAM role snippet for cross-account access and a minimal trust policy in the ticket.
priya (Security): We'll mark production integration as "requires on-prem or customer VPC + HSM". For the questionnaire we'll highlight mitigations for POC.
emily (Sales): Thanks. I'll push timeline with procurement and update the ticket when legal responds. Marking HIGH PRIORITY :warning:
